We network market-available sensors, effectors, or situational awareness systems into a tactical IoT backbone that reliably provides armed forces and security agencies with cross-domain information superiority \u2014 automated, scalable, and cost-efficient.<br><br>Our solutions integrate seamlessly into existing defense and maritime infrastructures, delivering fast data fusion and AI-enhanced analytics for robust situational awareness in dynamic environments. We build platform-agnostic systems that enable real interoperability across domains.<br><br>As a Staff Software Engineer, you'll directly impact the technical direction of our orchestration products \u2013 Hydris \u2013 the coordination engine for sensors and mission systems, and the interoperability API that underpins it.\u00a0<br><br>You'll work at the layer where heterogeneous real-world systems like radars, AIS receivers, LoRa mesh radios, satellite feeds, and C2 platforms become a single coherent picture. The problems lie in distributed systems, protocols, and data modeling areas. They play out in environments that are bandwidth-constrained, intermittently connected, and operationally unforgiving.\u00a0<br><br>The role is deeply hands-on, but it expects you to shape what we build and how we build it, not just deliver what's specified.<br><br>What you'll do<br>Core engine development<ul><li>Design and build the systems that power Hydris.<\/li><li>Go is your primary language. You should be comfortable reading Rust and TypeScript across the codebase, even if you're not writing in them day-to-day.<\/li><li>Own the architecture of a system that must run reliably on edge hardware, in disconnected mesh networks, and at scale \u2014 often all of that simultaneously.<\/li><\/ul>Protocol and integration architecture<ul><li>Evolve the schema that defines how every sensor, asset, and mission system talks to Hydris.<\/li><li>Make API design decisions that hold up across our client libraries without creating a maintenance burden.<\/li><li>Continue refining the integration framework that lets Hydris connect to new sensor types, data sources, and command systems.<\/li><li>Set the patterns for how built-in integrations (ADS-B, AIS, ASTERIX, Meshtastic, SpaceTrack, TAK, federation) are structured, tested, and maintained.<\/li><li>Make it straightforward for external developers and system vendors to build their own plugins\/integrations to Hydris.<\/li><\/ul>Distributed systems<ul><li>Architect the peer-to-peer mesh and federation layer that keeps Hydris operational in disconnected, denied, intermittent, and limited-bandwidth environments.<\/li><li>Solve the hard coordination problems: conflict resolution across federated nodes, eventual consistency of entity state, and track correlation across unreliable links.<\/li><li>Ensure the system degrades gracefully rather than failing completely when connectivity is lost or constrained.<\/li><\/ul>Technical leadership<ul><li>Set technical standards for the codebase: how we test distributed behavior, how we handle protocol versioning, how we think about backward compatibility in an API-first product.<\/li><li>Review code with a focus on long-term maintainability and operational correctness, not just feature completion.<\/li><li>Make build-versus-integrate decisions and help the team clearly understand the trade-offs.<\/li><\/ul><br>You should apply if you<ul><li>Have built and shipped distributed systems that run in production, ideally in environments where reliability matters more than convenience.<\/li><li>Are comfortable working across font-size: 10pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;&quot;&gt;Why Join Us?&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li style=&quot;font-size: 10pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;&quot;&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;font-size: 10pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;&quot;&gt;The software and systems you work on directly protect personnel and defend European and national sovereignty.&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li style=&quot;font-size: 10pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;&quot;&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;font-size: 10pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;&quot;&gt;You will work alongside industry-leading minds on autonomous systems, advanced propulsion, and secure cyber platforms.&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li style=&quot;font-size: 10pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;&quot;&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;font-size: 10pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;&quot;&gt;We foster a fast-paced, collaborative environment where bold ideas are supported by serious R&amp;amp;D backing.&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;&lt;\/div&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;text-decoration: underline; font-size: 10pt;&quot;&gt;&lt;strong&gt;About the Team&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;div class=&quot;TranslationField-module__fieldItem___g4pRX&quot;&gt;\n&lt;p class=&quot;TranslationField-module__fieldItemValue___c0djd&quot;&gt;You will join our hardware engineering team, working closely with engineers across propulsion, power systems, testing, and aircraft development to turn measured data into better-performing unmanned systems.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;\/div&gt;\n&lt;div class=&quot;TranslationField-module__fieldItem___g4pRX&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/div&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;text-decoration: underline; font-size: 10pt;&quot;&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Your Mission&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Your mission is to work hands-on with the parts of the aircraft that turn stored energy into flight: the&lt;br&gt;motors, the batteries, and the propulsion and power components that decide how far, how fast, and how&lt;br&gt;long our platforms fly. You support the hardware team from bench characterisation through data analysis&lt;br&gt;in MATLAB and Python.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;text-decoration: underline; font-size: 10pt;&quot;&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Responsibilities&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Support characterisation and bench testing of motors, propellers, batteries, and power components for our UAS platforms.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Help set up test rigs and instrumentation, and capture clean, repeatable measurement data.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Assist with component selection and trade-offs by turning test data into clear comparisons.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Reduce and analyse test data in MATLAB and Python \u2014 efficiency, thrust, endurance, thermal and discharge behaviour.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Visualise results so the engineering team can make decisions from them quickly.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Keep test setups, measurements, and findings documented and traceable.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;text-decoration: underline; font-size: 10pt;&quot;&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Required Skills&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Currently enrolled in a Bachelor&#39;s or Master&#39;s in Electrical, Mechanical, Aerospace, or a comparable engineering field.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Working knowledge of MATLAB and Python for data analysis.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Interest in and some exposure to UAS, electric propulsion (motors \/ ESCs), or battery \/ power systems.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Must be a citizen of a NATO member state (due to export control and security regulations).&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Practical, hands-on mindset \u2014 comfortable at the bench and with a multimeter as much as in a script.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Good written and verbal communication skills in English; We are currently hiring for multiple Software Engineering positions where the primary mission is to ensure our fleet maintains command, control, and situational awareness against near-peer threats.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Electronic Warfare (EW) is at the heart of everything we do. We\u2019re looking for engineers who are passionate about the electromagnetic spectrum and eager to join a team that lives and breathes RF. Whether you specialise in signal processing, communications, or EW effects, your background in EW and high-performance C++ is what matters most. We prioritise deep expertise and a drive to solve complex problems over meeting every single sub-specialty requirement.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;text-decoration: underline;&quot;&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Responsibilities&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Design high-performance C++ software for real-time signal processing, active electronic countermeasures.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Design algorithms for RF sensing, signal detection, and situational awareness to identify and neutralise threats in constraints.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Own the stack from initial design and mathematical modelling to rigorous bench testing and field Your work will be essential to ensuring that our autonomous multi-vehicle systems operate reliably in real-world, resource-constrained environments.&lt;\/em&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;text-decoration: underline; Systems) adapted for defense applications.&lt;\/em&gt;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li style=&quot;font-style: italic;&quot;&gt;&lt;em&gt;Prepare and manage safety-related documentation, including Safety Cases, As a premier defence technology company, our mission is clear: to equip NATO Allies and their partners &amp;nbsp;with next-generation autonomous defence platforms and advanced AI-driven software built to perform in the world\u2019s most demanding environments.&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;font-size: 10pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;&quot;&gt;We believe that true security stems from relentless innovation. By combining elite engineering talent with agile technology and an AI-native operational culture, Stark turns complex defence challenges into field-tested, multi-domain solutions.&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;br&gt;&lt;br&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;text-decoration: underline; font-size: 10pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;&quot;&gt;Why Join Us?&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li style=&quot;font-size: 10pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;&quot;&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;font-size: 10pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;&quot;&gt;The software and systems you work on directly protect personnel and defend European and national sovereignty.&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li style=&quot;font-size: 10pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;&quot;&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;font-size: 10pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;&quot;&gt;You will work alongside industry-leading minds on autonomous systems, advanced propulsion, and secure cyber platforms.&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li style=&quot;font-size: 10pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;&quot;&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;font-size: 10pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;&quot;&gt;We foster a fast-paced, collaborative environment where bold ideas are supported by serious R&amp;amp;D backing.&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;&lt;\/div&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;text-decoration: underline; font-size: 10pt;&quot;&gt;&lt;strong&gt;About the Team&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;em&gt;Minerva Frontline is STARK&#39;s command and control software \u2014 the brain that connects operators to autonomous systems across multiple domains in real time. The Frontline team is based across Europe &amp;amp; the UK, working with our hardware teams to build mission-critical C2 capabilities for use in active operational environments.&lt;\/em&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;em&gt;We move fast, ship real software, and operate under constraints most engineers never encounter \u2014 low-bandwidth networks, air-gapped devices, high-stakes decision loops. We are a tight-knit team of zero-ego, mission-driven developers. There is no room for abstraction for its own sake. Everything we build ends up in the hands of real operators in the field.&lt;\/em&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;em&gt;If you want to build software which will make a tangible difference to the security of Europe, we want to hear from you&lt;\/em&gt;.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;text-decoration: underline; font-size: 10pt;&quot;&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Your Mission&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;em&gt;STARK is looking for a &lt;strong&gt;Senior Software Engineer (Frontend Systems)&lt;\/strong&gt; to expand our mission management software. We are not looking for someone who just works on Jira tickets. We need a frontend systems thinker who balances rapid delivery with the deep system understanding required to answer: &#39;What is the right solution for the overall system, and what is the frontend&#39;s role in it?&#39;&lt;\/em&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;em&gt;You will build and evolve the frontend as a robust, high-performance architecture. You have the high-agency to navigate the physical constraints of our hardware, challenge the backend with hard questions, and translate complex data streams into a clear, calm UI for operators under extreme cognitive load. While you actively provide impulses for our overall system evolution, your core focus remains hands-on engineering.&lt;\/em&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;em&gt;We consistently rely on agentic AI workflows. While these agents accelerate development, they also introduce entirely new classes of technical challenges. Your role is to set strict architectural guardrails, rigorously orchestrate these agents, and collaborate with the team to solve the novel integration and quality problems that arise in this new engineering paradigm.&lt;\/em&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;text-decoration: underline; font-size: 10pt;&quot;&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Responsibilities&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li style=&quot;font-style: italic;&quot;&gt;&lt;em&gt;&lt;strong&gt;System Thinking through the Frontend Lens:&lt;\/strong&gt; You don&#39;t need to write path-planning algorithms, but you must understand how they constrain the UI. You engineer highly optimized frontend solutions that handle high-frequency telemetry and asynchronous data streams while strictly minimizing computational load to preserve critical battery life on field devices.&lt;\/em&gt;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li style=&quot;font-style: italic;&quot;&gt;&lt;em&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Mission-Critical UI &amp;amp; UX:&lt;\/strong&gt; You translate complex data into immediate situational awareness. You understand UX as cognitive load management for operators under stress. You implement interfaces that are deterministic, error-tolerant, and relentlessly focused on providing clarity out of chaos.&lt;\/em&gt;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li style=&quot;font-style: italic;&quot;&gt;&lt;em&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Strategic Sparring Partner:&lt;\/strong&gt; You align rapid delivery with long-term system health. Instead of just accepting what the backend provides, you proactively challenge APIs and data structures if they threaten frontend performance or the operator&#39;s experience.&lt;\/em&gt;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li style=&quot;font-style: italic;&quot;&gt;&lt;em&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Mastering Agentic Workflows:&lt;\/strong&gt; You don&#39;t just prompt; you engineer alongside AI. You set strict architectural guardrails, rigorously validate outputs, and proactively solve the novel integration and quality challenges that arise in this new paradigm.&lt;\/em&gt;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li style=&quot;font-style: italic;&quot;&gt;&lt;em&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Engineering for Extreme Constraints:&lt;\/strong&gt; Build high-performance, framework-less user interfaces (Vanilla TS, Web Components) that function flawlessly under extreme real-world conditions (low bandwidth, air-gapped networks).&lt;\/em&gt;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li style=&quot;font-style: italic;&quot;&gt;&lt;em&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Collaborative Excellence:&lt;\/strong&gt; You are a team multiplier. You view the frontend not as a collection of pages, but as a complex, stateful system interacting with the physical world.&lt;\/em&gt;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li style=&quot;font-style: italic;&quot;&gt;&lt;em&gt;Constraint-Driven Engineering: The ability to engineer solutions that anticipate and mitigate hardware realities\u2014specifically managing latency, handling data bursts, and optimizing for constrained compute and battery life.&lt;\/em&gt;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li style=&quot;font-style: italic;&quot;&gt;&lt;em&gt;AI-Engineering Competence: Practical experience integrating agent-based coding tools into your workflow. Combining deep domain expertise in hardware board design, thermal\/ structural packaging, real-time C++ signal processing, and resilient directional mesh networking, we rapidly build field advanced EW capabilities designed to survive and operate in contested spectrum environments.&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;text-decoration: underline; font-size: 10pt;&quot;&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Your Mission&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;You will architect and drive the design, integration, and deployment of mission-critical Electronic Warfare (EW) capabilities across STARK\u2019s platforms. Serving as a technical authority for critical hardware and RF systems, you will guide architecture from concept through simulation, layout, and field validation, ensuring our platforms deliver decisive overmatch in complex, dynamic RF environments.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;text-decoration: underline; font-size: 10pt;&quot;&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Responsibilities&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Lead end-to-end board design using Altium Designer, setting standards for High-Density Interconnect (HDI) techniques, stackup strategies, and complex high-frequency routing.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Oversee the design, simulation, and implementation of custom RF components, matching networks, and signal conditioning chains for contested environments.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Direct antenna design and placement simulations using CST Studio Suite and Altair FEKO to optimize platform-level RF performance and mitigate co-site interference.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Drive the mechanical packaging and electro-mechanical integration of hardware systems, collaborating with software, firmware, and mechanical teams to ensure seamless platform deployment.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Establish rigorous testing, debugging, and validation frameworks to guarantee hardware survivability and performance against strict defence and environmental standards.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Mentor junior and mid-level engineers, review technical designs, and contribute to long-term hardware roadmaps and architectural decisions.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;text-decoration: underline; font-size: 10pt;&quot;&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Required Skills&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;6+ years of professional engineering experience leading complex electronic, RF, or hardware systems development.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Expert-level proficiency in Altium Designer, with a track record of successfully bringing complex HDI, high-speed, and high-frequency PCBs to production.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Deep experience in RF circuit design, matching network optimization, and electromagnetic simulation using CST Studio Suite, Altair FEKO, or similar tools.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Proven ability to define multi-layer hardware architectures and translate broad operational requirements into robust engineering specifications.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Demonstrated track record of technical ownership in fast-paced, multi-disciplinary environments.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Advanced system-level debugging capability across hardware, RF, software, and firmware boundaries.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;B.S. or M.S. in Electrical, Electronic, Telecommunications, or Mechatronics Engineering (or equivalent experience).&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Direct experience in Defence, Aerospace, Telecommunications, or high-reliability hardware sectors.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Deep familiarity with RF spectrum management, signal processing techniques, or Software-Defined Radio (SDR) architectures.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;&lt;div class=&quot;content-conclusion&quot;&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;text-decoration: underline; font-size: 10pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;&quot;&gt;Equal Opportunity:&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;font-size: 10pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;&quot;&gt;At Stark Defence, we are committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and high-performing team. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values&amp;nbsp;and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. &lt;a href=&quot;https:\/\/www.youtube.com\/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI&quot;&gt;Co-create the future with us&lt;\/a&gt; as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;*&lt;em&gt;Fortune 500\u00ae is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.&lt;\/em&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;&lt;\/div&gt;&lt;h3&gt;&lt;strong&gt;An overview of this role&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/h3&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;As a Staff Backend Engineer on GitLab&#39;s Security Factory: Code Scanning team, you help developers find and fix security issues. Those issues live in the code they write, and you set the technical direction for the static analysis engine that finds them.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Your work spans two complementary parts of a complete security analysis. On the engine side, you shape how the static analysis toolkit models a program: parsing source into intermediate representations, resolving symbols, building call graphs, and tracking tainted data across files and languages. You define the architecture and specifications the team builds against, and you delegate component specifications within them to engineers and to the AI agents that implement them. On the evaluation side, you build and apply tooling that tests, measures, and validates what the engine finds against benchmark applications with known vulnerabilities.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;What the engine can model and how we measure what it finds are parts of one picture. As a Staff engineer you hold that picture, shape the long-range technical goals of the team, and raise the bar for every engineer on it. We build the engine with AI agents that write and review code from written specifications, under human direction. We expect you to direct that work effectively and with good judgment, and to help the team do the same.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;h3&gt;&lt;strong&gt;What you do&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/h3&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Act as the directly responsible individual (DRI) for the team&#39;s highest-scope initiatives from design through delivery, shipping large features with minimal guidance and shaping the long-range goals of the team&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Bring systems built by one engineer to team ownership through documentation, tests, and shared review&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Set the technical direction for the AI-assisted tooling that implements, reviews, and validates engine changes and findings, design the checks that decide whether an agent-written change or generated result is fit to merge, and measure detection quality against benchmark applications with known vulnerabilities, raising the bar for what counts as a trustworthy result. That includes static application security testing (SAST) rules mapped to CWE and OWASP, and the test fixtures that prove they work.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Own the architecture of the program model (parsing, symbol resolution, intermediate representations, call graphs, and taint and data-flow analysis) and of the pipeline that turns source code into findings, and define how both extend to new languages and frameworks&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Solve technical problems of the highest scope and complexity, actively seek out difficult impediments affecting the whole team, and advocate for improvements to quality, security, and performance with Product Management, UX, and partner teams such as Code Security and Composition Analysis&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Mentor all engineers on the team through code review and pairing, remove blockers to their autonomy, and shepherd the definition and improvement of our internal standards through review&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Participate in on-call rotations to assist troubleshooting product operations, security operations, and urgent engineering issues&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Define the overarching architecture and specification documents for the engine, delegate component specifications within them, and drive their implementation by AI agents and engineers working independently through phased plans, small reviewable units of change, and specifications kept in lockstep with the code&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Build and maintain the harness, agent instructions, and agentic skills that keep agent-written code trustworthy, including separate coding and reviewing agents, rules and tests the coding agents cannot change, independent review panels of agents from different model providers, and performance, API, and dependency gates, with risky changes escalated to human review&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Stay current with research in program analysis and security, run AI-assisted research and spikes, and turn the findings into prototypes, proposals, and upstream contributions, including responsible disclosure of findings in open source projects&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;h3&gt;&lt;strong&gt;What you bring&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/h3&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Experience building your own LLM tooling, such as a harness, an agent pipeline, or evaluations, with the judgment to know when output is trustworthy and when it isn&#39;t&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Extensive professional experience writing, testing, and reviewing production code in Rust, Go, or a comparable systems language, with depth in at least one. The engine is Rust, the analyzer wrapper is Go, and the monolith integration is Ruby, and we value willingness to work across them.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Experience with performance optimization and with containerized workflows and CI\/CD (we use Docker heavily)&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;A deep program analysis and static analysis background, such as parsing and ASTs, intermediate representations (SSA, control-flow and call graphs), taint and data-flow analysis, type inference, incremental and fixpoint computation, or writing detection rules, with the ability to read, evaluate, and apply the research literature&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Deep application security experience, such as vulnerability research, secure code review, or writing detection rules, and fluency with vulnerability classes (OWASP Top 10, CWE)&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Demonstrated capacity to communicate clearly and concisely about complex technical, architectural, and organizational problems, and to write architecture and design specifications that bring a team to a decision&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;A track record of taking ownership of ambiguous, team-wide problems and shipping them from concept to production with minimal guidance, with specific, regular async updates on progress, blockers, risks, and next steps&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Experience defining a system&#39;s overarching architecture, delegating component specifications to engineers and AI agents, and getting them implemented reliably&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;A track record of mentoring engineers, raising a team&#39;s technical bar, and influencing technical direction by achieving consensus with peers and leadership&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;h3&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Helpful experience&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/h3&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Familiarity with popular web or mobile application frameworks and how they handle input, data, and configuration&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Experience designing guardrails for agent-written code, such as mutation testing, fuzzing, and CI gates the coding agent cannot modify&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;A record of engaging with the research community, such as publications, tool papers, or upstream open source contributions in program analysis or security&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;h3&gt;&lt;strong&gt;About the team&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/h3&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;The Security Factory: Code Scanning team develops GitLab&#39;s SAST capabilities for customer software repositories.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;We work closely with the Code Security team on scanning rules &amp;amp; flows, with Composition Analysis on the broader software supply chain, and with other groups across the Sec Section. We rely heavily on asynchronous work across time zones.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;div class=&quot;c-message_actions__container c-message__actions&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/div&gt;\n&lt;div&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;font-size: xx-small;&quot;&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;color: white;&quot;&gt;Remote-Global&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/div&gt;&lt;div class=&quot;content-pay-transparency&quot;&gt;&lt;div class=&quot;pay-input&quot;&gt;&lt;div class=&quot;description&quot;&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;em&gt;The base salary range for this role\u2019s listed level is currently for residents of the&amp;nbsp;United States only. This range is intended to reflect the role&#39;s base salary rate in locations throughout the US.&amp;nbsp;Grade level and salary ranges are determined through interviews and a review of education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities of the applicant, equity with other team members, alignment with market data,&amp;nbsp;and geographic location.&amp;nbsp;The base salary range does not include any bonuses, equity, or benefits. You\u2019ll work primarily in Ruby on Rails on backend systems, including security dashboards, vulnerability reports, and ingestion pipelines. You\u2019ll take ownership of well-defined projects, solve technical problems with support from experienced team members, and collaborate with other engineers. internal standards&lt;\/a&gt; for style, maintainability, and best practices for a high-scale web environment&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Conduct code reviews within our&lt;a href=&quot;https:\/\/docs.gitlab.com\/development\/code_review\/&quot;&gt; More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.&lt;\/em&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;&lt;\/div&gt;&lt;h2&gt;&lt;strong&gt;An overview of this role&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/h2&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;As an Intermediate Backend Engineer (Python) in GitLab&#39;s Agent Foundations stage, you&#39;ll go beyond using AI tools. You&#39;ll help build the foundations for GitLab&#39;s agentic AI experiences: the platform that lets AI agents work across the whole software delivery lifecycle, not just write code. That covers the reusable building blocks agents and flows are made from as well as our core harness, Duo Developer.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Most of your work will be backend engineering in Python, using libraries such as LangGraph to build secure, reliable and scalable features in our AI Gateway. You&#39;ll also work across the stack where needed. You&#39;ll work closely with engineers across the stage and other AI Engineering teams. This is a high-visibility area where GitLab&#39;s core platform meets its AI strategy.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;h2&gt;&lt;strong&gt;What you&#39;ll do&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/h2&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Develop, ship and maintain features for the Duo Agent Platform in the Duo Workflow Service, the AI Gateway and, where needed, the GitLab monolith. Keep them secure, well-tested and performant.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Build and improve agentic flows and their reusable parts with LangChain and LangGraph, including the Flow Registry.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Work with Product Management, UX, frontend, backend and AI specialists to refine requirements and ship improvements in small iterations.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Design, implement and review APIs (including GraphQL and REST) and the backend logic behind them, with reliable, scalable and clear contracts for clients such as the GitLab monolith, IDE extensions and Duo CLI.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Improve and extend automated testing (pytest and other frameworks), including evaluations of agent and flow behavior, to strengthen quality and give developers faster feedback.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Share standards, patterns and learnings with other engineers to raise the bar for responsible AI integration and evidence-driven engineering.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Join Tier 2 &lt;a href=&quot;https:\/\/handbook.gitlab.com\/handbook\/engineering\/infrastructure-platforms\/incident-management\/on-call\/tier-2\/&quot;&gt;on-call rotations&lt;\/a&gt; to troubleshoot production issues, contribute to root cause analysis, and improve observability and resiliency.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Keep an eye on the competitive landscape to help keep GitLab&#39;s agent platform best-in-class as more work becomes agentic.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;h2&gt;&lt;strong&gt;What you&#39;ll bring&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/h2&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Experience building and maintaining production Python backend applications, including APIs, asynchronous or background processing, and data models.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Experience with LLM application frameworks such as LangGraph, or designing and shipping AI-powered backend features or harnesses.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Skill in designing or extending APIs (REST, GraphQL or gRPC) with attention to scalability, maintainability and backward compatibility.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Comfort working across the stack in a mature codebase. Familiarity with Ruby on Rails and\/or JavaScript and Vue is a plus.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Experience finding and fixing performance bottlenecks in applications.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Clear written and verbal communication, including technical proposals and documentation, in a remote, async, cross-functional team.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Openness to learning and to applying skills from related technologies or fields.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;h2&gt;&lt;strong&gt;About the team&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/h2&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;The &lt;a href=&quot;https:\/\/handbook.gitlab.com\/handbook\/engineering\/ai\/agent-foundations\/&quot;&gt;Agent Foundations stage&lt;\/a&gt; builds the foundations for GitLab&#39;s agentic AI experiences. We provide the platform, catalog and execution features that help teams deliver resilient agents and flows to customers. The stage has three groups: Agent Developer, AI Catalog and Agent Execution. Between them, they own the GitLab Duo Developer foundational flow and the Flow Registry; the AI Catalog, including custom agents, custom flows and external agent integrations; and agent execution, agent tools and agent observability.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Our engineers work async-first across EMEA, AMER, and India timezones. plan and manage workloads of the team.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Ensure client requirements are met whilst protecting DEPT\u00ae values\/brand.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Support the senior team with administrative tasks. \u2028&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Build a full understanding of the clients\u2019 business, strategies, objectives, brand,\u2028audiences and challenges, advising on the communications solution that best meets their needs, with a view to becoming their trusted adviser. \u2028&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Build excellent working relationships with key clients \u2013 regular meetings, planning, briefing, evaluation. \u2028&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Work closely with creative and strategy teams and to have oversight of all statements of work\/proposals as well as all content production for clients. \u2028&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Ensure the right DEPT\u00ae team is in place to deliver, high standards are maintained and adding value wherever possible. Ensure success criteria are met and projects are delivered to time and to budget. \u2028&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Ensure a good knowledge of all DEPT\u00ae products and services and actively promote them to clients. \u2028&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Report to senior management with internal and external issues and events that might impact upon accounts, either positively or negatively. \u2028&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Direct account management activity \u2013 undertaking pitches and presentations, formulating and implementing account plans, and running the account management process. \u2028&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Hold key new business development responsibilities, working with others in the team to proactively seek new opportunities for the business. Writing proposals and creative treatment. Contributing to winning new business. \u2028&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Ensure processes are followed and that there is consistent professional delivery (to brief). Managing workflows. scenes.&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;While you will gain exposure to both Finance and Supply Chain activities, this is not intended to be a fast-track management or leadership role, and Castrol brands are recognised globally for their premium quality and high performance, shaped by the company\u2019s commitment to innovation and cutting-edge technology. With products sold in more than 150 countries, Castrol has helped keep things moving on&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;span data-ogsc=&quot;rgb(0, 0, 0)&quot; data-olk-copy-source=&quot;MessageBody&quot;&gt; roads &lt;\/span&gt;&lt;span data-ogsc=&quot;rgb(0, 0, 0)&quot; data-olk-copy-source=&quot;MessageBody&quot;&gt;and racetracks, air, sea, and space for over 125 years.&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;color: rgb(101, 101, 101);&quot; data-ogsc=&quot;rgb(0, 0, 0)&quot;&gt;Whether you&#39;re just starting out or ready for your next big move, you&#39;re in the right place to explore an exciting career with Castrol.&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;h2&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;color: rgb(65, 145, 76);&quot; data-ogsc=&quot;rgb(0, 0, 0)&quot;&gt;Job description&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/h2&gt;&lt;\/div&gt;&lt;h4&gt;About the Team&lt;\/h4&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;At Castrol, we don\u2019t just make fluids, we help define the future of mobility, energy and digital infrastructure. The Advanced Electrification Testing (AET) team sits within Castrol\u2019s Technology organisation and plays a critical role in supporting Research &amp;amp; Product Development by generating real-world performance data on lubricants, thermal management fluids and cooling technologies. Our mission is to understand how liquids perform inside the systems they are designed to protect and optimise, from electric vehicle batteries and ultra-fast chargers to high-performance data centres and advanced electronics.&lt;br&gt;As part of a major investment programme, Castrol\u2019s Pangbourne Technology Centre is evolving into a centre of excellence for electrification and energy technologies. The team operates world-class testing facilities including battery cell, module and pack laboratories, high-voltage charging systems, immersion cooling tanks, data centre server environments and large-scale thermal management test rigs.&lt;br&gt;This is a team for engineers who are naturally curious. You&#39;ll work in an environment that combines the freedom of university-style research with the pace and impact of commercial product development. One day you may be investigating battery cooling performance, the next developing new testing methodologies for data centre technologies or semiconductor cooling systems.&lt;br&gt;You&#39;ll join a highly collaborative group of engineers, technicians, graduates and researchers who are passionate about solving complex engineering challenges. We are looking for individuals who love understanding how things work, enjoy getting hands-on with equipment, and want to help create the next generation of high-performance technologies.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;h4&gt;Key Tasks&lt;\/h4&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;As a Senior Engineer, you will lead research and development testing projects from concept through to final technical recommendations, working closely with internal stakeholders, technology experts and external partners.&lt;br&gt;&lt;br&gt;Key responsibilities include:&lt;br&gt;&lt;br&gt;- Leading end-to-end testing and engineering projects supporting Castrol&#39;s research and product development programmes.&lt;br&gt;- Designing, building, commissioning and operating advanced test rigs and experimental systems.&lt;br&gt;- Developing innovative testing methodologies for emerging technologies across electric vehicles, batteries, charging infrastructure and data centres.&lt;br&gt;- Designing experiments using statistical Design of Experiments (DoE) techniques and ensuring data quality and repeatability.&lt;br&gt;- Performing advanced data analysis and translating results into meaningful engineering insights and recommendations.&lt;br&gt;- Working hands-on with high-voltage systems, instrumentation, thermal management equipment and power electronics.&lt;br&gt;- Supporting the installation, operation and continuous improvement of testing facilities and equipment.&lt;br&gt;- Acting as a subject matter expert in one or more areas such as battery systems, thermal management, data centres, cooling technologies, power electronics or DC power systems.&lt;br&gt;-&amp;nbsp;Collaborating with OEMs, technology partners and internal stakeholders to deliver co-engineered solutions.&lt;br&gt;- Coaching and mentoring engineers, technicians, graduates and interns while acting as a technical role model within the team.&lt;br&gt;- Identifying new technologies, testing opportunities and research directions that strengthen Castrol&#39;s innovation capability.&lt;br&gt;- Representing Castrol externally through technical engagement with customers, industry partners and research organisations.&lt;br&gt;- Maintaining the highest standards of safety, operational excellence and engineering integrity across all activities.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;h4&gt;Experience Required&lt;\/h4&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;We&#39;re looking for an experienced, hands-on engineer with a passion for experimentation, problem-solving and developing new technologies.&lt;br&gt;&lt;br&gt;You will typically bring:&lt;br&gt;&lt;br&gt;- Degree-qualified in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Physics or a related engineering discipline.&lt;br&gt;- 5+ years&#39; experience in a professional engineering environment or equivalent in academia.&lt;br&gt;- A strong background in engineering testing, experimental design and data-driven problem solving.&lt;br&gt;- Experience designing, building or operating complex test equipment and test rigs.&lt;br&gt;- Exposure to safety-critical or operational engineering environments.&lt;br&gt;- Knowledge of high-voltage electrical systems (typically &amp;gt;60V DC) and safe working practices.&lt;br&gt;- Strong technical reporting, communication and stakeholder management skills.&lt;br&gt;- The ability to work autonomously while leading projects and influencing technical direction.&lt;br&gt;- A curiosity-driven mindset and a genuine passion for engineering and technology.&lt;br&gt;&lt;br&gt;Expertise in at least one of the following areas:&lt;br&gt;- Electric vehicle propulsion systems&lt;br&gt;- Battery technologies&lt;br&gt;- Thermal management and cooling systems&lt;br&gt;- Data centre technologies&lt;br&gt;- DC power systems&lt;br&gt;- Power electronics&lt;br&gt;- Electronics and instrumentation&lt;br&gt;&lt;br&gt;Desirable experience includes:&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;- Master&#39;s degree, PhD or progression towards Chartered Engineer status.&lt;br&gt;- Experience of battery thermal management, immersion cooling or liquid cooling technologies.&lt;br&gt;- Knowledge of semiconductor or chip cooling applications.&lt;br&gt;- Experience with advanced measurement techniques, data analytics or CAE tools.&lt;br&gt;- Published technical papers or involvement in research programmes.&lt;br&gt;- Experience gained within automotive, battery, aerospace, power, data centre or advanced research environments.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;This role is ideal for engineers who want more than a traditional testing position. Working alongside colleagues with pricing and commercial expertise, you&#39;ll combine technical problem-solving with developing others, turning your team&#39;s analysis into decisions that improve revenue, margin and product mix.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;h4&gt;Key tasks&lt;\/h4&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Which pricing questions are worth solving, and how do you turn the answers into something the business can use? You&#39;ll help connect the commercial problem, the analytical approach and the practical solution.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Find where margin is being lost across discounts, rebates and trade investments. Quantify the opportunity, recommend corrective action and support governance of pricing corridors, floors and exceptions.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Help the business make better product-price-pack and portfolio choices across DIY, DIFM and B2B channels. Explore customers, segments, specifications, pack sizes and tiers to inform price positioning and the price steps between offerings.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Develop and deploy models for elasticity, demand forecasting, willingness to pay, price sensitivity, scenarios and price optimisation, translating the results into recommendations people can act on.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Turn recurring work into repeatable tools. Design automation for price changes, analysis, reporting and decision support, reducing manual intervention and making solutions usable across markets.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Lead and develop your analytical team, encouraging commercial curiosity and innovation. Set priorities around business value, plan projects and help colleagues turn their technical work into practical outcomes.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Partner with Pricing, Sales, Finance and Marketing, using clear explanations of the evidence to influence senior stakeholders and connect analytical findings to commercial decisions.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Success means more than delivering a model: it means measurable commercial impact, pricing processes that need less manual effort, and a team that understands its priorities and develops its capabilities.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;h4&gt;Experience required&lt;\/h4&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;You don&#39;t need a long management career behind you. You&#39;ll need technical depth, evidence that your analysis makes a difference, and the aptitude to help others do their best work.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;A university degree or higher, with proven experience in pricing analytics, data science or operations research, ideally in a commercial environment.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Strong mathematical and statistical modelling skills, including regression, machine learning and segmentation, and the ability to apply them to questions such as demand forecasting, elasticity and price optimisation.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Proficiency in analytical tools such as Python, R and SQL and visualisation platforms such as Power BI or Tableau, with experience working with large datasets and building scalable solutions.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Evidence of translating analysis into business impact, supported by commercial judgement, problem-solving and decision-making skills.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;The ability and aptitude to lead and develop a small analytical team. Previous leadership or mentoring experience is valuable, but strong technical candidates with less management experience will also be considered.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Experience delivering and leading projects, with the initiative, planning, prioritisation and collaborative approach needed to keep work moving.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Fluent written and spoken English, with the ability to explain complex findings, influence stakeholders at different levels and build relationships within and beyond Global Pricing.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Desirable: pricing or revenue growth management experience, including gross-to-net, trade spend and portfolio\/mix optimisation. Bringing together global expertise across seven Technology Centres in formulation science, chemistry, engineering, product development and testing, we co-engineer solutions that optimise performance for customers across traditional lubricant applications and emerging technologies.&lt;br&gt;We\u2019re now hiring a Lubricants Senior Technologist to join our UK Technology Centre in Reading, supporting the Castrol Europe Performance Unit.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;You\u2019ll be part of the Technology Deployment Team, working at the interface between Global R&amp;amp;D, Sales, Marketing, Supply Chain, manufacturing and OEM technology teams. The team plays a critical role in turning product innovation into commercially successful solutions for customers across Europe.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;This is a highly collaborative role for someone who combines strong technical expertise with commercial awareness and stakeholder influence. You\u2019ll have the opportunity to work across functions and markets, shape the successful introduction of new lubricant technologies and help solve complex technical challenges for one of the teams.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Coordinate technical specifications, blending requirements, plant trials, testing and formulation approvals.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Provide technical troubleshooting support for manufacturing and blending issues, including raw material shortages, quality incidents and customer complaints.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Ensure product claims are technically substantiated and aligned with regulatory and marketing requirements.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Develop and deliver technical communications and training to support new product launches, adapting global materials for regional and local audiences.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Provide technical input into tenders, new market opportunities, procurement evaluations and formulation optimisation.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Identify opportunities to improve formulation cost competitiveness, supply resilience and overall product We&#39;re now part of Mastercard, and together we&#39;re building a network for every form of money \u2013 one that delivers more reach, more capability and more choice.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;We enable businesses to build financial products, unlock new markets, and move money in seconds across 130+ countries, with 40+ licenses for fiat and digital assets globally. Processing billions annually, we empower enterprises worldwide to send, receive, convert, and settle stablecoins and fiat seamlessly through a single integration.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Our mission is to accelerate global money movement, and we&#39;re assembling a world-class team to make it happen.&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Trusted by industry leaders like Corpay, Worldpay, Deel, and Flywire, we deliver the infrastructure that makes new forms of money usable within the financial systems customers already rely on today.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;By combining Mastercard&#39;s global payment reach and trusted networks with BVNK&#39;s stablecoin infrastructure, we&#39;re building the trusted operating layer for the evolution of money movement, helping customers participate in emerging digital networks without having to rebuild their businesses around every new innovation.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;We&#39;re a diverse team spread across EMEA, North America, and APAC, with a shared belief that stablecoins are the new infrastructure layer for financial services, and that BVNK is at the forefront of this shift.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;We&#39;re incredibly honored to have been recognized by:&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;CNBC World&#39;s Top Fintech Companies (2026)&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;FXC Intelligence Top 100 Cross-border Payment Companies (2026)&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Newsweek&#39;s The Top 100 Global Most Loved Workplaces (three years running, most recently 2025)&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;LinkedIn as one of the Top 20 Startups in the UK (2025)&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;About this role in the team:&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;We&#39;re looking for a Product Manager to own the product vision, strategy, and delivery for the Reporting &amp;amp; Customer Reconciliation subdomain within BVNK&#39;s Ledger domain. You&#39;ll&amp;nbsp; work closely with engineering, design, finance, operations, and commercial teams to define how BVNK&#39;s customers&amp;nbsp; and BVNK&#39;s own internal teams \u2014 see, understand, and trust their financial data.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;The Ledger domain is the financial backbone of BVNK, a single, trusted source of truth for all customer and transactional balances across products, currencies, and rails. Within this domain, the Reporting &amp;amp; Customer Reconciliation subdomain is responsible for providing clear, consistent financial views derived from the ledger for both internal and external reporting. Through the Reporting Service, Search Service, and downstream data surfaces,it ensures that positions, balances, and movements are accurately represented for Finance, Risk, Operations, and customers.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;This is a high-impact, cross-functional role. As part of BVNK&#39;s Billing 2.0 vision and the drive toward a 100% self-serve customer experience, you&#39;ll define and deliver the product capabilities that give customers full transparency; enabling them to reconcile invoices, audit charges programmatically, and automate close processes, while also building the internal reporting foundations that Finance, Reconciliation, and Operations depend on to scale.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;h4&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Key Areas of Responsibilities:&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/h4&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Own the product vision and roadmap for Reporting &amp;amp; Customer Reconciliation&lt;\/strong&gt; \u2014 Define the strategy for how BVNK exposes financial data to customers and internal teams, aligning with the broader Ledger domain mission and company objectives (Billing 2.0, self-serve experience, MiCA compliance).&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Drive transaction report fee breakdowns&lt;\/strong&gt; \u2014 Define requirements and work with engineering to ensure transaction reports and APIs properly include both real-time and invoiced fees, broken down by fee type&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Build the customer reconciliation product &lt;\/strong&gt;\u2014 Define and deliver customer-facing reconciliation endpoints and reporting surfaces that enable enterprise clients to programmatically audit charges, automate close processes, and reconcile against invoices.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Improve internal financial reporting&lt;\/strong&gt; \u2014 Partner with Finance, Reconciliation, and Operations to understand their data needs and deliver standardised reports and views that replace fragmented, manual processes with reliable, automated data pipelines.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Collaborate across domains &lt;\/strong&gt;\u2014 Work with the Billing &amp;amp; Fees, Wallets, Balances , Digital Assets, Treasury, and Reconciliation domain to ensure reporting data is consistent and accurate end-to-end.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Define reporting for multi-entity and regulatory requirements&lt;\/strong&gt; \u2014 As BVNK expands across jurisdictions and customer types, ensure reporting structures correctly represent entity-specific data, segregation requirements, and regulatory obligations (MiCA safekeeping, EMI reconciliation).&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Own stakeholder relationships &lt;\/strong&gt;\u2014 Serve as the primary product contact for Reporting &amp;amp; Customer Reconciliation. Engage regularly with Commercial (AMs\/CSMs), Finance, Operations, and enterprise customers to gather requirements, validate solutions, and communicate roadmap priorities.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Measure and iterate&lt;\/strong&gt; \u2014 Define and track KPIs for reporting accuracy, customer adoption of reconciliation tools, reduction in manual reconciliation effort, and internal stakeholder satisfaction. Use data to inform roadmap prioritisation and demonstrate impact.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Ship with quality&lt;\/strong&gt; \u2014 Write clear PRDs, user stories, and acceptance criteria. Participate in architecture reviews and technical design submissions. Run beta programmes with select customers and internal teams to validate reporting capabilities before general availability.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;What we need from you:&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;5+ years of product management experience in fintech, payments, or financial services \u2014 ideally with exposure to ledger systems, financial reporting, or reconciliation products.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Deep understanding of financial data and reporting \u2014 you&#39;ve worked with transaction data, balance reporting, reconciliation workflows, or invoicing systems. You understand concepts like double-entry bookkeeping, ledger postings, balance snapshots, and fee structures or can learn them quickly.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Experience building internal and customer-facing data products \u2014 you&#39;ve defined and delivered reporting APIs, dashboards, data exports, or reconciliation tools that serve both external customers and internal operations teams.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Strong cross-functional collaboration skills \u2014 you&#39;re comfortable working with engineering, finance, operations, compliance, and commercial teams. You can translate complex financial requirements into clear product specifications and negotiate priorities across stakeholders with competing needs.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Data-driven decision making \u2014 you use quantitative and qualitative data to inform roadmap decisions, measure product impact, and communicate outcomes to leadership.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Technical fluency \u2014 you don&#39;t need to write code, but you can engage meaningfully with engineers on API design, data models, event-driven architectures, and database schemas. You&#39;re comfortable with tools like Snowflake, QuickSight, or similar BI\/data warehousing platforms.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Experience in a fast-paced, scaling environment \u2014 you&#39;ve operated in a startup or scale-up where scope is broad, resources are constrained, and you need to make pragmatic trade-offs between ideal and achievable.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Excellent written and verbal communication \u2014 you write clear PRDs, run effective stakeholder meetings, and can present product strategy to senior leadership with confidence.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Remote-first mindset \u2014 you&#39;re effectively working across time zones in an asynchronous-first culture, using Slack, Confluence, and Jira as primary collaboration tools.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Nice to have:&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Experience with regulated financial services (EMI, VASP) and compliance reporting requirements (MiCA, safeguarding, client money rules).&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Background in B2B payments platforms, stablecoin infrastructure, or crypto-adjacent products.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Familiarity with reconciliation platforms (Duco, Xero, or similar) and financial ledger systems.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Experience working with multi-tenant architectures and entity-level data segregation.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Understanding of event-driven data pipelines (Kafka, outbox patterns) and how they impact data consistency in reporting.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Product experience with self-serve billing or invoicing platforms.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;What you can expect from us:&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Fair and &lt;strong&gt;competitive salary&lt;\/strong&gt; at every stage of your growth&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Flexible working&lt;\/strong&gt; hours, with hybrid working at its heart&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;A &lt;strong&gt;culture&lt;\/strong&gt; built on passionate, growth-minded people&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;A &lt;strong&gt;flexible approach to holiday&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Opportunities to travel to our &lt;strong&gt;offices around the world&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;An &lt;strong&gt;open and creative environment&lt;\/strong&gt; where you can help us define the future of BVNK, its culture, and its opportunity sets&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;em&gt;At BVNK, we are focused on building a diverse and inclusive team. For Mega App this means. Digital twins, CMS systems, Web front and back end.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Can hold a credible conversation with engineering leads, and with the client, about technical trade-offs that affect the creative ambition.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Does not need to be hands-on. Then you might be just the Senior Application Consultant we are looking for!&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;h2&gt;What will your day look like?&lt;\/h2&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;As our new Senior Application Consultant (SFMC&lt;strong&gt;)&lt;\/strong&gt;, you will play a pivotal technical lead role within our development and consultancy teams. You will deal with complex, moving pieces and lead the creation of highly efficient, scalable marketing campaign solutions for global brands. You will bridge the gap between technology and high-level marketing strategy, working directly with senior client stakeholders to translate complex business objectives into robust SFMC technical architectures.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;In addition to hands-on configuration and technical execution, you will serve as a subject matter expert and mentor, guiding cross-functional delivery teams and ensuring technical solutions align with overarching client goals.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;More specifically, your tasks include:&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Leading cross-functional collaboration across operations, product, and client teams to ensure seamless enterprise delivery and long-term client success.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Championing the strategic adoption and expansion of Catalyst tools across our global client base, architecting tailored end-to-end solutions.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Streamlining complex client operations by designing and configuring advanced business logic, custom scripts (SSJS\/AMPscript), and automated workflows in SFMC.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Translating complex client requirements into scalable technical specifications, architecture blueprints, and data models.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Establishing quality assurance and testing standards to guarantee the reliability of complex configurations, custom code, and new platform features.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Serving as a primary point of technical escalation to troubleshoot and resolve high-level application issues across SFMC environments.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Leading requirements-gathering workshops with senior client marketers to translate business objectives into advanced technical solutions.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Managing complex data architecture, SQL queries, and audience segmentation while ensuring data integrity, governance, and security.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Mentoring and upskilling junior Application Consultants and Specialists, fostering technical excellence across the team.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Proactively identifying opportunities to enhance and optimize the Catalyst platform and its features for enterprise clients.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;h2&gt;Who are you going to work with?&lt;\/h2&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;You will join a senior team of developers, technical architects, data specialists, product managers, and project managers who are passionate about building enterprise products and customer experiences. Because finance plays a pivotal role in business, our mission is to put it back in its rightful place - serving merchants and consumers.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Our installment and deferred payment solutions help merchants boost sales by 20% or more, increase customer loyalty, and deliver a seamless shopping experience - without encouraging bad debt.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;As the buy now pay later leader in France and active in 10 European countries, we&#39;ve empowered over +25,000 merchants and 10 million consumers.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;With 400+ Almakers and \u20ac100M+ ARR, Alma is scaling rapidly across Europe as a member of the Next40, and we&#39;re just getting started!&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;h2&gt;&lt;strong&gt;About the team&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/h2&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Strategic Finance is part of Alma&#39;s Finance team and reports to the CFO. Our job is to understand Alma&#39;s economics better than anyone: we own the top line, the unit economics and the Contribution Margin, and we turn that knowledge into decisions on pricing, partnerships, markets and products.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;We are organising the team so that each person owns a piece of Alma&#39;s P&amp;amp;L from start to finish: its business plan, its recurring analysis, its key finance processes, its business partners and its Board materials. Depending on the scope, that piece can be payments and partnerships, our existing merchant base, or new business and growth, each with one or more European markets attached.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;h2&gt;&lt;strong&gt;About the job&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/h2&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Own your piece of the P&amp;amp;L.&lt;\/strong&gt; Build and maintain its business plan, follow its performance month after month, and explain what moves the numbers and why, all the way up to the Board.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Run the key finance processes of your scope.&lt;\/strong&gt; Depending on the scope: pricing, merchant performance reviews, cost and margin analysis, country reviews. You are accountable for their quality, and for making them better at every cycle.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Be a real partner to the business.&lt;\/strong&gt; Work day to day with the commercial, product and operations teams, step back from the numbers, and bring a clear recommendation whenever a decision is on the table.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Rebuild how finance works with AI.&lt;\/strong&gt; Prototype AI-assisted workflows, industrialise the ones that work, and free up the team&#39;s time for analysis and influence. Raising the bar on &lt;em&gt;how&lt;\/em&gt; we work matters as much as &lt;em&gt;what&lt;\/em&gt; we deliver.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;h2&gt;&lt;strong&gt;You will work with&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/h2&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Google Sheets \u00b7 Excel \u00b7 SQL (largely AI-assisted) \u00b7 Notion \u00b7 Slack \u00b7 AI assistants and LLMs&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;h2&gt;&lt;strong&gt;&amp;nbsp;About you&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/h2&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;To succeed in this job&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Have 6 to 7 years of experience in strategic finance, FP&amp;amp;A, transaction services, consulting or a similar analytical role, ideally including time in a fast-growing company.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Model with ease and think in unit economics: you can build a business plan from raw data and spot when a number doesn&#39;t make sense. Querying is largely AI-assisted at Alma, so data judgement matters more than deep SQL.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Have a strong appetite for AI and learn fast. Ideally, you have already built AI-assisted workflows and made them stick.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Take ownership and bring business sense: you make a scope your own, you know when to step back, and you can influence people who don&#39;t report to you. Manager","description":"&lt;h2&gt;\ud83e\udde1 About Alma&lt;\/h2&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;At Alma, we believe sustainable commerce depends on fair, well-balanced trade. Because finance plays a pivotal role in business, our mission is to put it back in its rightful place \u2014 serving merchants and consumers.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Our installment and deferred payment solutions help merchants boost sales by 20% or more, increase customer loyalty, and deliver a seamless shopping experience \u2014 without encouraging bad debt.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;As the buy now pay later leader in France and active in 10 European countries, we&#39;ve empowered over +25,000 merchants and 10 million consumers.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;With 380+ Almakers and \u20ac100M+ ARR in 2025, Alma is scaling rapidly across Europe as a member of the Next40, and we&#39;re just getting started!&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;h2&gt;\ud83d\udc50 About the team&lt;\/h2&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Alma is a lender. We originate several million consumer receivables a year, carry them for a few weeks, and refinance them off a deliberately light balance sheet through securitization vehicles (Fonds Communs de Titrisation) and our other funding lines. We are regulated as a soci\u00e9t\u00e9 de financement and a payment institution.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;That changes what &quot;accounting&quot; means here. A lender&#39;s accounts are not a monthly deliverable produced at the end of a chain: &lt;strong&gt;they are the chain&lt;\/strong&gt;. Every payment event, every commission, every provision, every sale of receivables to an FCT has to become a journal entry that ties \u2014 to the transaction underneath it, to the general ledger above it, and to the prudential statements the regulator reads. At our scale and growth, this is a strategic topic, and one that is as much about data as it is about accounting.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Today the chain exists: an internal core banking ledger we built ourselves, feeding NetSuite, feeding regulatory reporting. What it does not have is a single owner who understands it end-to-end, holds it to the standard a regulated lender needs, and evolves it as the business changes (geographies, products, licenses). That is the role we are opening.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;You will join an Accounting team inside a Finance organization of ~15 people covering Strategic Financing, FP&amp;amp;A, Accounting, Regulatory reporting and Controlling. You will report to the Head of Financing &amp;amp; Accounting, alongside the Financing team and the General Accounting Manager, who oversees corporate cycles, tax, statutory and consolidated accounts.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;This is a role with unusual ownership for its level: the banking accounting scope is yours from day one, and so is the data chain that produces it.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;h2&gt;\ud83d\udcbc About the job&lt;\/h2&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Own the accounting of the credit business:&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Own how the portfolio is represented in the books: origination, revenue recognition on merchant and customer commissions, deferred income, write-offs and recoveries, cost of risk and provisioning on performing and non-performing exposures.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Own the accounting of our securitizations: sales of receivables to the FCTs, derecognition, discount and over-collateralisation, residual interests, servicing and management fees, hedging.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Own the accounting of our funding: corporate debt, commercial paper, and the new funding instruments we add as the refinancing strategy evolves.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Own the core banking ledger:&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Be the functional owner of the engine that turns business events into accounting: which event, which account, which currency, which date, which counterparty.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Specify and validate the accounting schemes for every new product, partner and geography, and work with Engineering and Data on the ledger&#39;s model, its feed into the ERP, and the fixes when something drifts.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Own the audit trail end-to-end \u2014 from a single \u20ac40 installment to a line in a prudential statement \u2014 and make it documented enough to be walked through by someone whose job is to challenge it.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Reinforce the control framework:&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Design and automate the reconciliations that hold the whole thing together: ledger \u2194 general ledger \u2194 bank \u2194 FCT reporting \u2194 prudential statements.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Shorten monthly close, incl. turning a manual, end-of-month, spreadsheet-based check into an automated, evidenced, repeatable control.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Be Finance&#39;s counterpart to Internal Control and Periodic Control on everything accounting-data related.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Own regulatory reporting:&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Own the production and the quality of our prudential and statistical reporting \u2014 solvency, large exposures, liquidity, and the statistical returns that go with them.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Own the reconciliation tables that matter most: prudential statements to accounting balances, regulatory returns to the trial balance, own funds and RWA back to their audit trail.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Own the reporting tooling and its data feeds, and work with the Regulatory and Financing teams on the evolutions of the prudential framework and on the treatment of our securitizations.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;h2&gt;\ud83e\udde9 About you&lt;\/h2&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;To succeed in this job:&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;You have around 6-7 years of experience, ideally starting in audit of financial services \u2014 banks, consumer credit, asset management, securitization \u2014 in a Big 4 or a specialised practice, possibly with a first move in-house. You know how to build a number, prove it, and defend it line by line in front of people whose job is to challenge it.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;You know banking accounting for real: French banking GAAP, the PCEC, cost of risk, revenue recognition on credit products. Or you know financial services accounting well enough that the banking layer is a matter of months, not years.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;You actually enjoy controls at scale \u2014 reconciling large populations, hunting the anomaly, chasing the last twelve euros of a four-hundred-million balance until you know exactly where they went. If that sounds tedious rather than satisfying, this is not your role.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;You are autonomous and scrappy. On things to build, or on things that already exist.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;You are fluent in English and French \u2014 our documentation and our regulator are French, part of our business and our team are not.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;And it will be nice if you also:&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Hold, or are working towards, the DEC (or CPA, ACCA, equivalent).&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Have been exposed to securitization \u2014 FCTs, SPVs, waterfalls, deconsolidation \u2014 or to a regulated credit institution from the inside.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;You are autonomous on data.&lt;\/strong&gt; SQL is a daily tool, a data warehouse does not intimidate you, and your reflex in front of a five-million-row population is to query it, not to ask someone for a summary. This is the single most important line in this job description.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Know NetSuite, BigQuery, dbt or Python.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Have worked in a scaling fintech.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Don&#39;t meet every single requirement? At Alma, we believe great hires come from diverse paths. If this role excites you, we encourage you to apply. During the interview process, you&#39;ll receive detailed information about the available features and their contribution to the overall project.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;As an intern, you will be working with more senior software engineers every day on a potential future feature of our product. With guidance and support, you will be able to code, debug, optimize, and document your work while learning how to deliver qualitative work.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;The stack may differ from one frontend.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Here are &lt;strong&gt;some examples &lt;\/strong&gt;of previous projects our interns worked on:&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;text-decoration: underline;&quot;&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Unsupervised models:&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Improve the tooling available for data scientists to train unsupervised (clustering) models in Dataiku&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;If time allows, extend further to optimize the training and inference of those types of models&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;text-decoration: underline;&quot;&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Webapp vibe coding:&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Build an intelligent \u201cvibe coding\u201d
