natural-language descriptions into usable web components, accelerating web app development for users without deep front-end expertise&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;text-decoration: underline;&quot;&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Dynamic model management:&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Improve management of AI models accessible on already-deployed software to unlock new capabilities without upgrading&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Leverage Dataiku\u2019s LLM Mesh and accelerate customer adoption, helping shape Dataiku\u2019s strategy for agentic AI in the enterprise&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;text-decoration: underline;&quot;&gt;&lt;strong&gt;AI-powered code generation:&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Develop and integrate more low-setup code completion features into Dataiku&#39;s embedded code editors&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;As a time-permitting extension, investigate and potentially implement more AI-powered code generation capabilities to further enhance the coding experience&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;text-decoration: underline;&quot;&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Flow Search:&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Significantly enhance the search and filtering capabilities for Dataiku&#39;s complex data pipelines by introducing advanced operators&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Implement this powerful search feature by defining a formal query grammar, building an Abstract Syntax Tree (AST) to parse user input, and developing a user-friendly interface with live autocompletion and intelligent error feedback&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;text-decoration: underline;&quot;&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Internationalization:&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Actively contribute to the internationalization of the Dataiku platform by allowing faster translation of new and existing software components into various languages beyond English&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Improve and optimize the entire internationalization workflow by implementing technical solutions such as lazy loading for resources, automating translations with LLMs, and developing tools for automated error detection&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;text-decoration: underline;&quot;&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Files Processor:&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Develop a versatile, all-in-one file processing tool within Dataiku to perform a wide range of transformations and filtering Every day in the U.S., people make 35 million trips of 50\u2013500 miles, stuck in traffic or routed through crowded hubs. Chances are, you&#39;ve been one of them. At Electra, we&#39;re changing that with the EL9, a nine-passenger, hybrid-electric aircraft that takes off and lands in just 150 feet. Our Ultra Short technology opens up thousands of new places to fly, beyond conventional runways, congested airports and long drives. We&#39;re backed by Lockheed Martin, Honeywell and Safran. Operators worldwide have signed intent-to-purchase agreements for the first 2,200 aircraft we produce, and we&#39;re moving toward first test flights in 2027.&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;&quot;&gt;Getting a new kind of aircraft airborne takes more than ambition. It takes our kind of bold: people who think big while working in the real world. Who move ideas into action and collaborate without silos. Who put people first and make room at the table for everyone. Who challenge one another without diminishing one another.&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;&quot;&gt;Sound like you? Then look beyond what you thought were your own limits, and help us take flight beyond runways.&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;&lt;\/div&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;The Role&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;As Electra&#39;s Senior Structural Assembly Manufacturing Engineer, you&#39;ll play a key role in developing and industrializing the structural assembly processes for the EL9 aircraft, working from early product development through prototype build, production implementation, and ramp-up.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;You&#39;ll work closely with Product Engineering during aircraft development to ensure structural designs incorporate Design for Manufacturing and Assembly (DFMA) principles and can be efficiently, repeatably, and reliably produced. You&#39;ll bring a hands-on manufacturing perspective to structural design decisions, evaluating assembly sequence, tolerance management, access, tooling, fastening and joining methods, inspection requirements, producibility, and production risk.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;As the EL9 transitions from design into physical hardware, you&#39;ll help translate released engineering into executable manufacturing processes and support prototype and initial aircraft builds. You&#39;ll work closely with airframe manufacturing suppliers, providing on-site Manufacturing Engineering oversight and liaison support as needed to ensure proper information flow, resolve technical and quality issues, support the incorporation of product changes and support supply chain on contract management.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;This is an opportunity to influence both how the aircraft is designed and how it is ultimately built, while helping establish Electra&#39;s structural assembly manufacturing supply chain capability from the ground up.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;What You&#39;ll Do&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Partner with Product Engineering throughout aircraft development to ensure structural designs incorporate Design for Manufacturing and Assembly (DFMA) principles and support efficient, repeatable, and scalable production.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Review aircraft structural designs, assemblies, drawings, models, and engineering changes from a manufacturing perspective, providing recommendations related to producibility, assembly sequence, access, tolerance stack-up, fastening and joining methods, tooling, inspection, and production risk.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Participate in design trade studies, concept reviews, and design reviews, representing Manufacturing Engineering and identifying manufacturing constraints and opportunities early in the development cycle.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Provide Manufacturing Engineering oversight and liaison support at airframe and structural suppliers, working directly with supplier manufacturing teams to clarify design and manufacturing intent, resolve producibility and assembly issues, and maintain program execution.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Work closely with the airframe supplier Tooling Engineering to define assembly tooling concepts, requirements, locating strategies, interfaces, and implementation plans.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Review supplier manufacturing approaches, build plans, assembly processes, tooling concepts, and production readiness to ensure alignment with Electra&#39;s engineering requirements and program objectives.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Support prototype fabrication, development aircraft assembly, first builds, and production implementation, providing hands-on Manufacturing Engineering support to resolve issues encountered during structural assembly.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Coordinate technical resolution of manufacturing issues and nonconformances with Product Engineering, Stress, Quality, Supplier Quality, Supply Chain, and other stakeholders.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Capture manufacturing lessons learned and supplier feedback from prototype and initial production builds and drive those If that thought feels overwhelming, you might want to pause here, but if it sparks excitement...read on&lt;\/span&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;br&gt;&lt;span data-contrast=&quot;auto&quot;&gt;\u202f&lt;\/span&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;br&gt;&lt;span data-contrast=&quot;auto&quot;&gt;In 2015, we pioneered a \u201cmoneyball for biotech\u201d approach, pooling projects and promising early-stage research from academia together under one financial umbrella to reduce risk and unleash innovation. This model allows\u202fscience and small teams of experts to lead the way. We build bridges to groundbreaking advancements in rare&amp;nbsp;disease, and&amp;nbsp;develop life-changing medicines for patients with unmet needs as fast as humanly possible.\u202f&lt;\/span&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;br&gt;&lt;span data-contrast=&quot;auto&quot;&gt;\u202f&lt;\/span&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;br&gt;&lt;span data-contrast=&quot;auto&quot;&gt;Together we define white space, push boundaries, and empower people to solve problems. If you&#39;re someone who defies convention, join us and work alongside some of the most respected minds in the industry. Together, we&#39;ll&amp;nbsp;ask&amp;nbsp;&quot;why not?&quot; and help reengineer the future of biopharma. At BridgeBio, we value curiosity and experimentation\u2014including the ethical &amp;amp; thoughtful use of AI to improve clarity, speed, and quality of work.&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;span data-ccp-props=&quot;{&amp;quot;134233117&amp;quot;:true,&amp;quot;134233118&amp;quot;:true,&amp;quot;201341983&amp;quot;:0,&amp;quot;335559740&amp;quot;:240}&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;&lt;\/div&gt;&lt;p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;h4&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;text-decoration: underline;&quot;&gt;About BridgeBio Pharma, Inc.&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/h4&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;BridgeBio is a biopharmaceutical company dedicated to discovering, developing, and delivering transformative medicines for patients living with genetic diseases and genetically defined cancers. Since our founding in 2015, we have built a diverse portfolio of more than 20 drug development programs, ranging from early discovery to late-stage clinical trials, across multiple therapeutic areas including precision oncology, cardiology, endocrinology, neurology, and renal disease. We have already achieved regulatory approval for three therapies and continue to advance promising science from academia into meaningful treatments for patients worldwide.&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;h4&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;text-decoration: underline;&quot;&gt;Who We Are&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/h4&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;BridgeBio is a global biotechnology company with our Global Headquarters located in San Francisco, USA, and our International HQ located in Zug, Switzerland. Since establishing our European presence in 2021, we\u2019ve been building empowered, high-performing teams across countries \u2014 with experienced colleagues who move quickly, take ownership, and are fueling the company\u2019s international growth.&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;At BridgeBio, you\u2019ll find an energetic and collaborative culture where pragmatism meets bold decision-making. We embrace uncertainty with confidence, guided by our commitment to making a meaningful impact for patients. Our people are trusted and empowered, united by urgency, purpose, and the drive to advance science for patients around the world.&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;To learn more about our story and company culture, visit us at &lt;a href=&quot;https:\/\/bridgebio.com&quot;&gt;https:\/\/bridgebio.com&lt;\/a&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;&lt;u&gt;What You\u2019ll Do&lt;\/u&gt;&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;You will report to the VP, Head of Market Access, International and work closely with international Market Access, regional brand team, and heads or markets access in BridgeBio clusters as well as with field-based colleagues across multiple geographies, to drive strategic initiatives that support BridgeBio\u2019s mission of delivering transformative medicines to patients globally.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Your primary purpose will be to secure timely, sustainable patient access to the company\u2019s products by shaping the value narrative, and leading pricing and reimbursement strategies and execution across multiple international markets. This includes oversight of related dossiers, negotiations, and cost coverage approaches. In this role you ensure alignment of Market Access ambitions with clinical value and global pricing interdependencies.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;You will also be a core member of the International Market Access team, contributing to global decision-making and ensuring alignment across regions while representing diverse market perspectives.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;This role requires strong collaboration with cross-functional colleagues and external stakeholders across multiple countries to ensure high-quality execution and impact. The ideal candidate combines deep expertise in Market Access processes across several international markets and experience introducing innovative therapies in a global biotech environment. You are eager to make a meaningful contribution in pre-launch and launch phases, particularly within rare diseases and orphan conditions, and bring strong communication skills, adaptability, and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, hands-on environment.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;&lt;u&gt;Responsibilities&lt;\/u&gt;&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Represent the payer perspective within cross-functional, cross-regional commercialization teams thereby optimizing pricing and market access of the asset.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Closely collaborate with HEOR and clusters&#39; leadership teams, Marketing and Clinical Development counterparts to ensure value and access optimization for the asset.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Lead early payer engagement with key HTA\/payer bodies (e.g. NICE UK, G-BA Germany) to inform evidence generation strategy, value proposition and reimbursement dossiers development.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Interact with internal and external experts in pricing, health economics, patient advocacy, health technology assessment authorities, government policy makers and payers as required to execute Pricing &amp;amp; Reimbursement objectives.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Provide hands-on support and train local access teams on negotiation strategy and ensure HTA and reimbursement submissions are aligned to the Global and International strategy.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;&lt;u&gt;Where You\u2019ll Work&amp;nbsp; &lt;\/u&gt;&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;This is an office role based and requires in-office collaboration 2-3x per week in our Zug Office.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;&lt;u&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/u&gt;&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;strong&gt;&lt;u&gt;Who You Are&lt;\/u&gt;&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Extensive experience leading HTA submissions and pricing negotiations across multiple international markets, ideally including Europe and other global regions, particularly in rare diseases and orphan conditions.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Strong knowledge of international healthcare systems, pricing and reimbursement frameworks, and regulatory environments.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Experience generating and leveraging data for HTA submissions and pricing negotiations, with a strong external network of agencies and stakeholders.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Comfortable presenting at senior levels and engaging with external thought leaders globally.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Proven experience managing complex, cross-functional and multicultural teams (including external partners).&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Knowledge of product commercialization processes with a hands-on, solution-oriented mindset for building scalable processes and documentation.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;&lt;u&gt;Rewarding Those Who Make the Mission Possible&lt;\/u&gt;&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;We have high expectations for our team members.
